title: Add source-bound PR4504 replay for aliased temporary roots
body:
PR4504's frame audit resolves each copied destination against an unresolved temporary root, so benign macOS `/var` aliases fail before the source constructor runs. This isolated successor authenticates all thirteen live inputs and runs the exact frozen verifier with a canonical temporary root, restoring the prior setting afterward. It rejects authoring arguments and leaves every scientific source, receipt and selected record unchanged. The maintainer review already identified the diagnosis and workaround; this contribution adds the executable source-bound replay and regression controls.

Validation on macOS arm64 / Python 3.12.2:
- Five boundary groups pass normally and under `-O`: explicit alias/canonical controls, relative/absolute/interior-symlink escape rejection, source drift before compilation, temporary-state restoration and authoring rejection.
- The complete unchanged PR4504 audit passes in both orientations with all eleven semantic negative controls and exact `RESULT.json` equality (4.60 seconds).
- Registered replay, metadata/source pins, nineteen-file committed-byte/source-history preflight and Git-free export replay pass; exported bytes remain unchanged.

[Canonical investigation and claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4500#discussioncomment-19129412). No new kappa, full selected-family replay, native Windows result or concurrent-filesystem guarantee. Credit Mihir Srivastava / mihir-s-05, Douglas Colkitt's maintainer review and the retained construction lineage. Prepared for Brian with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.
